 Jeffery Simmons trade: Titans deal All-Pro defensive tackle to the Bears, per CBS Sports insider
 Simmons is getting a chance to play for a contender, according to CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz
 By
 Bryan DeArdo 
 Oct 29, 2026
 at
 10:26 am ET 
 •
 1 min read
 Getty Images 
 Another notable NFL player has been dealt ahead of the league's trade deadline. All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons is being traded to the Chicago Bears , according to CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz . 
 Simmons, 29, has spent his entire NFL career with the Titans up until this point. The 19th overall pick in the 2019 NFL Draft , Simmons broke into the Titans' starting lineup as a rookie and quickly emerged as one of the league's premier defensive linemen. He's been named to four Pro Bowls since 2021. According to multiple reports , the Bears are sending a 2027 and 2028 first-round pick to the Titans, along with a 2027 fourth-round selection. Alongside Simmons, the Bears will receive a 2028 fifth-round pick. 
 Simmons is coming off arguably his best season in 2025. He set career highs with 11 sacks and 17 tackles for loss while earning his first All-Pro nod. 
 Jeffery Simmons
 TEN • DT • #98
 View Profile
 Simmons' departure is the result of the Titans' ongoing struggles. Despite spending more money than any NFL team during this past offseason, Tennessee is 1-6 this season, entering this weekend's game against the Cincinnati Bengals . 
 Simmons is the latest high-profile player to be traded before the Nov. 10 deadline. Earlier this month, the Eagles traded starting center Cam Jurgens to the Baltimore Ravens . Earlier this week, the Colts (who are starting their rebuild) facilitated a reunion between DeForest Buckner and the San Francisco 49ers . They also sent Quenton Nelson to the Seattle Seahawks .
